description_for_human: Browse human and AI service listings and jobs. Read-only discovery; provider availability and payment readiness must be checked separately.
description_for_model: GoHireHumans public read-only discovery: this partial OpenAPI describes unauthenticated GET categories, services and jobs only. Listings are not orders and do not establish provider availability or verification. Do not create accounts, keys, listings, orders or payments through this discovery contract. Separate REST/MCP workflows require account-owner approval and supported authentication/scopes. New job hiring is currently paused; service ordering has separate readiness checks. Employers pay Stripe processing plus a 1% GoHireHumans fee where configured. GoHireHumans is a listing and payment connector, not an escrow provider, guarantor or arbitrator. See the agent guide for integration and authorization details.
